name: TouristAttracions_no_va

framework_config.system_prompt: You are generating a conversation about what to do during an upcoming trip.

initial_prompt: Create a converation between friends exciting to go on a trip together. They are discussing what they want to do during the trip and how the weather might affect their plans.

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Excited traveler looking forward to go sightseeing anround the city and visit tourist attractions.

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Chill person looking forward to relax and enjoy the trip. They are not very interested in sightseeing and tourist attractions, they would rather spend time in a park or on the beach.

user3.name: User3
user3.role: Relaxed and easy going traveler who is open to different activities during the trip. They are not very concerned about the weather and are willing to adapt their plans accordingly.

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Ambient household assistant. Not addressed in this scenario.

variations.context: Checking plans for the day against weather prediction

setting.relationship_dynamic: Group of old friends travelling together
setting.background: The group is going an a vacation together. They traveled toghether beforeand know each other well.
